title: Write KP Asset Calculus doctrine spec

title: Write KP Asset Calculus composition law spec
summary: Added composition laws for object identity, selector closure, provenance, transformations, diagrams, behaviors, interpreters, ports, flashcards, law levels, and failure policy.

title: Write LLM authoring guide for KP assets
summary: Added a practical guide for LLM and human authors covering object, selector, transformation, diagram, behavior, interpreter, port, decomposition, flashcard, review, and anti-pattern rules.

title: Expose Asset Calculus framework rows in the dashboard
summary: Added dashboard work and protocol-gallery rows for KP Asset Calculus doctrine, composition laws, and the asset authoring guide, with search, preview, and Theseus adapter coverage.

title: Define core SemanticObject asset interfaces
summary: Added the first KP asset core module with semantic asset objects, selectors, bundles, provenance, diagnostics, selector lookup, and structural validation for duplicate ids and selector closure.

title: Define SemanticTransformation source and target contracts
summary: Added KP semantic transformation contracts with source and target object ids, preservation tags, selector correspondence, law refs, endpoint validation, and adjacent sequencing compatibility checks.

title: Define SemanticDiagram composition forms
summary: Added semantic diagram composition for transformation leaves, sequences, parallels, tree substitution, source-target boundary checks, leaf transformation ids, forward phases, and exact rewind phase ordering.

title: Define KpBehavior time sampling protocol
summary: Added the KpBehavior protocol with normalized sample context, clamped time sampling, progress sampling, invalid duration checks, and duration reparameterization that preserves semantic progress.

title: Define timeline and event protocol
summary: Added timeline specs with beats, events, checkpoints, pauses, active beat sampling, elapsed event sampling, duration clamping, and validation for beat/event ids and bounds.

title: Define interpreter contract for render/export backends
summary: Added a generic KP interpreter contract with target kinds, input kind, preservation level, normalized interpretation output, and explicit diagnostics for lax or lossy mappings.

title: Define external deterministic port contract
summary: Added an external port contract for deterministic imports into KP asset bundles, including source system/version metadata, preservation level, run wrapper, and explicit approximate/lossy/opaque/partial/unsupported diagnostics.

title: Define flashcard spec contract
summary: Added flashcard specs that reference asset ids, object ids, selector ids, transformation ids, time slices, and answers, plus validation so cards cannot silently drift from source assets.

title: Add law-test helper utilities
summary: Added reusable law helpers for behavior determinism, behavior duration reparameterization, and diagram rewind phase equivalence, with structured pass/failure results for future canonical examples.

title: Wrap linear solve as an AssetBundle
summary: Added a canonical linear-solve KP asset wrapper with manifest-aligned equation object ids, selector metadata, transformation contracts, correspondence maps, and a sequence diagram without changing the existing renderer.
